whatThisIs: A RECORD of one real run, not a reproducible fixture. The run directory is gitignored, so nobody can recompute these numbers from this repository alone; the run identity below is what a reader checks them against. Every number names the ledger it came from and no number here is a ratio.

run.targetWorkingTree: all five repos: staged 0, modified 0, behind origin/master 0, before and after the run

requestShaping.subject: Client project management
requestShaping.aliasLanguage: English only — the issue's pre-run measurement found Chinese aliases hit 0 (客户) and 1 (项目) files across the five repos, so they would occupy the vocabulary without navigating anywhere. Output language stays zh-CN.
requestShaping.statusExcluded: `status` was kept out of aliases deliberately: it hits 539 files across the five repos and is what pulled leave, reimbursement and performance into the previous round's decision-branch denominator.
requestShaping.budgetNote: maxFeatureNodes was raised from the 440 first tried because at 440 the fact pack marked entrypoints, entities and states `truncated: true` with the note 'the feature scope node cap was reached upstream'. At 1200 those three rows read truncated:false (entrypoints 491 items, states 25, config-keys 40, external-calls 49, logic 316) and the cap warning disappeared. maxSourceWindows was never binding: the run reported requiredRunWindowBudget 1159 against availableWindows 1710.

numeratorOnlyFamilies.denominatorReason: no producer enumerates how many states, validation rules or interface strings this capability has, so these are counts of what the report named, never a share of what exists

namedCeilings.subject: the window-recall ceiling on the read-obligation denominator is not landed
namedCeilings.measuredHere: the boundary is 79 files and 903 decision-function obligations, all of it selected by one English alias set; 69 of 1019 counted read obligations were never opened (11 carrying this feature's vocabulary, 58 carrying none)
namedCeilings.consequence: the decision-branch denominator is biased in both directions at once — too wide where an alias is a common word (project, position), too narrow where a branch carries none of the vocabulary. The absolute numbers here are comparable ONLY against another run on the same target with the same alias set.

namedCeilings.subject: the fact pack's six structural categories have no per-item coverage denominator on the unit path
namedCeilings.measuredHere: none of the 12 units carries a reading whose denominator is entrypoints / entities / states / config-keys / jobs / external-calls; the accounting runs on obligations and frozen evidence instead
namedCeilings.consequence: citations are audited, coverage is not: every page, field and rule the document names is bound to evidence and would be caught if invented, and a page the document never names triggers no finding at all

namedCeilings.subject: 197 database tables are nameable and 0 are covered by an obligation
namedCeilings.measuredHere: the entity facet holds 197 topics, every one of them unobligated; this document names none of them, because chapter 6 is forbidden to carry table names
namedCeilings.consequence: the storage side of this capability is outside what any gate in this run measures

namedCeilings.subject: the form-validation family has no denominator
namedCeilings.measuredHere: the 433 crossrepo frontend-call facts became no topic and bind no obligation; the document states 112 validation rules with evidence and nothing counts how many exist
namedCeilings.consequence: the question 'what share of the form rules is written down' has no answer in this run

namedCeilings.subject: the process-state family has no denominator
namedCeilings.measuredHere: no producer enumerates a state machine; the document names 91 state statements, 89 of them evidence-backed
namedCeilings.consequence: the same as above for states

namedCeilings.subject: a batch claim whose statement is a chapter-level sentence is a wildcard carrier
namedCeilings.measuredHere: 927 of the 929 obligations u03-rules owns (903 decision-function + 24 logic-disposition) were grounded by 24 batch claims that all reuse the chapter's opening sentence as their statement, each citing exactly its own batch's evidence ids
namedCeilings.consequence: grounding says every rescued decision function is answered by chapter 3 as a whole, not that any individual one has its own sentence. The claim-binding audit reads 'complete' either way. This is the same shape the previous round used (73 claims linking 766 obligations) and it is recorded rather than hidden.

namedCeilings.subject: 950 read obligations had a window opened and no claim cites it
namedCeilings.consequence: reading a span and reporting what it says are two different accounts; this run closed the first and left most of the second to the batch grounding above

namedCeilings.subject: 144 of 145 literal domain conditions inside opened windows are stated by no claim
namedCeilings.measuredHere: audit advisory over coverage/condition-inventory.json (86 numeric, 59 string-enum)
namedCeilings.consequence: chapter 3 carries the boundary values that belong to the client-and-project capability; the residual is dominated by conditions in files the alias set dragged in (OAuth, worklog export, leave)

defectsFound.what: `required` only checks presence, so a --start/--end that does not parse reaches the recorder as NaN. The run committed an evidence record with startLine null, endLine null, empty content and the digest of the empty string (S-d41cb011fa, wcp-service/routes/projects.js:NaN-NaN).
defectsFound.cost: freeze then refuses the whole run by name — 'S-d41cb011fa source evidence is missing path or line range' (src/investigation/assurance.ts:276) — and there is no command that withdraws a recorded evidence id, so the run was unrecoverable and had to be re-prepared and the whole investigation replayed.
defectsFound.shape: a guard that exists one layer too late: the value is validated where it is consumed rather than where it is accepted, so a fail-closed check turns into a poisoned artifact
defectsFound.disposition: out of this slice's scope (evidence run, zero src changes). Reported for its own slice.
